text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
What brings you all the way out here?
choice_data_list: It's already time for training, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I'm sorry!
I just got so caught up in the movie!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
There was so much great staging to take notes on...
I started jotting it down so I wouldn't forget, and before I knew it, it got this late...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's great that she's so passionate about her research.
Even so, I made sure to give her a stern warning about being late to training.
